description: Dispatch a run of an Operator Workflow. Returns the QUEUED run (id, pinned version, per-step states) — poll anyforge_get_workflow_run for progress. Runs pause at gate steps for an operator decision. Requires `write` scope. Only dispatch when the operator asked for it — a run spends tokens.

inputs.description: Run inputs matching the spec's declared inputs (see anyforge_get_workflow).

name: anyforge_run_workflow
title: Run workflow
